CODELEARN · F11 — ADMIN STATISTICS

FER202 final assignment (mini LMS) · Function 11 of 11 · Starter = reference of F10 · Suggested time: 90 minutes · Total: 10 marks

1. Overview

The last screen gives the admin numbers: totals, an estimated revenue, the quiz pass rate, the most popular courses and three bar charts. No chart library is needed — a bar chart is a few <rect> elements in an inline SVG whose heights are proportional to the values. All numbers are computed in the browser from the raw collections with pure functions (utils/stats.js), so nothing is hard-coded and the page is right for any data.

API calls

GET /users, GET /courses, GET /enrollments, GET /results, GET /categories — in parallel with Promise.all; #refresh-stats loads again.

Definitions

IdValue
#stat-courses (+ #stat-published "N published")all courses (drafts included)
#stat-studentsusers with role student (locked ones included)
#stat-enrollmentsnumber of enrolments
#stat-revenueΣ price of the course of every enrolment, formatted "598.000 ₫" (free = 0)
#stat-pass-ratepassed attempts ÷ all attempts, rounded, "50%" (no attempts ⇒ 0%)
popular coursescourses with ≥ 1 enrolment, most enrolments first, ties by title A→Z, top 5
enrolments per monthgroup by enrolledAt.slice(0, 7), oldest first, label "09/2026"
enrolments per categoryevery category (0 included), in category order

Bar chart (component BarChart)

Props { id, title, data: [{ label, value }] }; renders <svg id={id}> with, for each item, rect.bar (height = Math.round(value / max × 150), so the biggest bar is 150), text.bar-value and text.bar-label. All values 0 ⇒ no division by zero.

Main features

  • Summary numbers · Most popular courses · SVG bar charts · Access, refresh & pure functions

General requirements

  • Continue from your own F10 code (or the starter, which is the F10 reference). Files marked NEW/EDIT in the tree are the ones this step touches.
  • Create React App (React 18), React Router v6, Redux Toolkit, Axios, React-Bootstrap; json-server 0.17.4 on port 9999 (1.x dropped _expand/_embed).
  • Every HTTP call goes through src/api/*.js (one axiosClient with baseURL: process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL); each API function returns response.data itself — do not rely on interceptors (the auto-grader’s axios does not run them).
  • Keep the ids/classes printed in the brief — the auto-grader uses them. Components never call axios directly.

4. Data model

db.json — 8 collections (json-server 0.17.4, port 9999)

FieldTypeNotes
users{ id, fullName, email, password, role: "admin" | "student", active: boolean, createdAt }email stored lower-case and unique · active:false = locked (cannot log in)
categories{ id, name }Frontend · Backend · Database · Mobile
courses{ id, title, categoryId → categories, level, price, instructor, description, thumbnail, published, createdAt }level ∈ Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced · price in VND (0 = Free) · published:false = draft (admin only)

enrollments{ id, userId → users, courseId → courses, enrolledAt, completedLessons: number[] }progress lives here (ids of completed lessons, sorted, no duplicates)
results{ id, userId, courseId, chapterId → chapters, score, total, percent, passed, answers: number[], submittedAt }one row per quiz attempt · pass mark 70%

5. Functional requirements

1. Summary numbers 3 marks

Requirements:

  • Route /admin/stats (sidebar #admin-nav-stats): #stat-courses, #stat-published, #stat-students, #stat-enrollments, #stat-revenue, #stat-pass-rate — each id on the element whose text is the value.

Must use: Promise.all reduce

Example:

seed ⇒ 10 · 4 · 6 · 598.000 ₫ · 50%

2. Most popular courses 2.5 marks

Requirements:

  • #popular-table rows tr.popular-row with .popular-title and .popular-count, sorted as defined; none ⇒ #no-popular.

Must use: sort with tie-break

3. SVG bar charts 3 marks

Requirements:

  • components/BarChart.js used three times: #chart-popular (popular courses, labels "#1"…), #chart-months, #chart-categories.

Must use: SVG rect reusable component

4. Access, refresh & pure functions 1.5 marks

Requirements:

  • Admin only (student ⇒ 403); #refresh-stats reloads; calculations in utils/stats.js › computeStats(data) (no numbers hard-coded — the grader runs it on other data too).

6. Element ids / classes used by the auto-grader

SelectorPurpose
#admin-nav-stats #admin-stats-title #refresh-stats #stats-errorpage
#stat-courses #stat-published #stat-students #stat-enrollments #stat-revenue #stat-pass-ratevalue elements
#popular-table tr.popular-row .popular-title .popular-count #no-popularpopular courses
svg#chart-popular · svg#chart-months · svg#chart-categories — rect.bar text.bar-value text.bar-labelcharts

7. Grading rubric

#FeatureMarks
1Summary numbers3
2Most popular courses2.5
3SVG bar charts3
4Access, refresh & pure functions1.5
Total10

Common deductions

  • Typing the expected numbers into JSX (fails as soon as data changes).
  • Importing a heavy chart library for three bar charts.
  • Hard-coded http://localhost:9999 in components instead of the .env variable.
  • Mutating Redux/React state, or writing localStorage inside a reducer.
  • App crashes (white screen) on an empty list, an unknown id or a server error.

8. Submission

Work in the editor (files on the right) or download the starter, then npm install and npm run dev (json-server :9999 + React :3000) and paste your files back. Press Run for the sample checks and Submit for full grading (hidden checks included). The reference solution of this step unlocks after an Accepted submission.

CODELEARN · F11 — ADMIN: THỐNG KÊ

Assignment cuối kỳ FER202 (mini LMS) · Chức năng 11/11 · Starter = lời giải F10 · Thời gian gợi ý: 90 phút · Tổng: 10 điểm

1. Tổng quan

Màn hình cuối cho admin các con số: tổng, doanh thu ước tính, tỉ lệ đạt quiz, các khoá phổ biến nhất và ba biểu đồ cột. Không cần thư viện biểu đồ — biểu đồ cột chỉ là vài phần tử <rect> trong một SVG nội tuyến, chiều cao tỉ lệ với giá trị. Mọi con số tính ở trình duyệt từ các bảng thô bằng hàm thuần (utils/stats.js) ⇒ không viết cứng số nào, dữ liệu nào trang cũng đúng.

Lời gọi API

GET /users, GET /courses, GET /enrollments, GET /results, GET /categories — song song bằng Promise.all; #refresh-stats tải lại.

Định nghĩa

IdGiá trị
#stat-courses (+ #stat-published "N published")mọi khoá (kể cả nháp)
#stat-studentsngười có role student (kể cả bị khoá)
#stat-enrollmentssố lượt ghi danh
#stat-revenueΣ giá khoá của từng lượt ghi danh, định dạng "598.000 ₫" (miễn phí = 0)
#stat-pass-ratelượt đạt ÷ mọi lượt làm quiz, làm tròn, "50%" (chưa có lượt nào ⇒ 0%)
khoá phổ biếnkhoá có ≥ 1 lượt ghi danh, nhiều nhất trước, hoà thì theo tên A→Z, lấy 5
ghi danh theo thánggom theo enrolledAt.slice(0, 7), tháng cũ trước, nhãn "09/2026"
ghi danh theo danh mụcmọi danh mục (kể cả 0), theo thứ tự danh mục

Biểu đồ cột (component BarChart)

Props { id, title, data: [{ label, value }] }; vẽ <svg id={id}>, mỗi mục có rect.bar (cao = Math.round(value / max × 150) ⇒ cột lớn nhất cao 150), text.bar-value và text.bar-label. Toàn giá trị 0 ⇒ không chia cho 0.

Chức năng chính

  • Các chỉ số tổng · Khoá phổ biến nhất · Biểu đồ cột SVG · Quyền, làm mới & hàm thuần

# CodeLearn — mini LMS (FER202 final assignment)

ReactJS (Create React App) · React Router 6 · Redux Toolkit · Axios · React-Bootstrap · json-server 0.17.4

## Run

```bash
npm install              # React 18 is pinned: CRA now installs React 19 by default (peer conflicts)
npm run dev              # json-server :9999 + React :3000 together (concurrently)
```

Or in two terminals: `npm run server` and `npm start`. Restart `npm start` after editing `.env`.
